edit.description: log_path's .git file -> gitdir -> commondir resolution (198-242) moves to one shared resolver that log_path calls
ignore_walk (637) and discovers_path (723-760) both read the exclude under the resolved common git dir; require_git stays false
linked-worktree cases: the walk skips the common exclude's path, and discovers_path agrees

summary: In a linked worktree, discovery and the single-path query both miss the common git dir's info/exclude. One shared worktree-chain resolver feeds both
acceptance: In a harness whose `.git` is a worktree pointer file, a path the common git dir's info/exclude names is undiscoverable to both check's walk and discovers_path. tap::log_path resolves through the same one resolver
tests: the discovery walk in a linked worktree skips a path the common git dir's info/exclude names
the single path query agrees with the discovery walk in a linked worktree
pins: a .gitignore still prunes the discovery walk in a tree with no .git
notes: Install says discovery honors the repository's ignore rules. In a linked worktree git reads info/ from $GIT_COMMON_DIR (gitrepository-layout(5), 'info', git 2.43.0, read 2026-11-24). ignore 0.4.27 resolves .git files only with require_git(true), which drops .gitignore in non-git trees (see the pin). It keeps resolve_git_commondir private, so reuse tap::log_path's resolver rather than writing a second one. Keep the patterns anchored at the harness root, not at info/.

interface.changes: tap::log_path, ignore_walk and discovers_path call one crate-internal resolver for a harness's common git dir
interface.hides: how a worktree pointer file chains through gitdir and commondir
interface.rejected: require_git(true): lets the crate resolve the pointer but drops .gitignore honoring in non-git trees, which ignore_walk keeps on purpose
